# POST /api/v1/orgs/{org}/avatar

Update the avatar of an organization

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (reqToken + reqOrgOwnership) · **ID:** `ep-037`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `UpdateUserAvatarOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `image` | string | True | binding:Required, must be base64 encoded image data |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — invalid base64 encoding
- **404** — organization not found

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |

| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | orgAssignment(true) + reqOrgOwnership() | utility | resolve org; verify ownership |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Avatar image must be valid base64 and supported image type (png/jpeg/gif/webp) | validation | imgType != png/jpeg/gif/webp |
| Avatar image dimensions must not exceed configured max (default 4096x4096) | validation | imgCfg.Width > setting.Avatar.MaxWidth || imgCfg.Height > setting.Avatar.MaxHeight |
| Small avatar images (< MaxOriginSize=256KB) are stored as-is without processing | business_logic | len(data) < maxOriginSize |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| invalid base64 in image field | 400 | bad request | False |
| unsupported type or too large | 500 | internal error | False |

### Error Paths

- **invalid base64** → UpdateAvatar → 400
- **unsupported image type** → UploadAvatar → 500
- **image too large (width/height)** → UploadAvatar → 500
- **storage write fails** → UploadAvatar → 500

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| low | synchronous_blocking | Image processing (decode, crop, resize) happens synchronously on request thread | Acceptable for avatar uploads which are infrequent; MaxWidth/MaxHeight limits bound the worst case |

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** medium

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| non_atomic | ✅ configured | low | DB update and storage write are in same transaction; if storage fails, DB rolls back |
| timeout | ❌ missing | medium | No explicit timeout on storage write operation |

**Cascading failure risk:** Storage backend failure causes avatar upload to fail; org remains functional

**Graceful degradation:** Falls back to default avatar if upload fails
